name: Dram
overview: The term 'dram' (also called drachm) refers to a Persian coin of varying estimated value used in the Old Testament, particularly during the post-exilic period. Scripture records generous contributions of gold measured in drams toward the rebuilding efforts, as seen in Ezra and Nehemiah, highlighting the faithful giving of the people for God's work. These passages demonstrate the practical means by which God's people supported the restoration of worship and community, emphasizing stewardship and dedication to the Lord's purposes.
